description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources used in the combined training data. The chart contains nine slices, each representing a different data source. The largest slice is labeled “SCIFACT” and is colored light blue, representing 31.3% of the total. “SNLI” is the next largest, colored pink and accounting for 15.4%. Following this is “FEVE”, colored coral and representing 16.1%, then “MULTINLI”, colored light green and representing 11.3%. “VITAMINC” is colored orange and represents 13.0%, while “SCIITALK” is colored yellow and represents 4.2%. “PUBHEALTH” is colored light teal and represents 0.5%, “FACTCC” is colored gold and represents 2.6%, and finally “ENTFA” is colored red and represents 1.8%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend is present to identify each data source. The slices appear to be ordered visually in a clockwise direction, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
